moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view with a centre crosshair: a smooth grey field, lighter at the top and darker along the bottom edge.
A dark shape with a long dark trail behind it sits below and right of the crosshair; faint vertical bands cross the picture.
After a black frame, closer views of the dark shape near the crosshair, then it slides out to the right.
The dark shape and its trail come back in from the left; the sensor holds it just above and right of the crosshair.
A faint light smudge appears at the upper left beside the black box and drifts diagonally down to the bottom edge, right of centre. About 3 s.
Zoomed in: the dark shape sits on the crosshair with its trail pointing to the upper left.
After a flash, a close view of a mottled grey surface. A tiny bright dot sits just right of the crosshair, later drifting lower right.
A second tiny bright dot enters at the left edge and drifts right until both dots are beside the crosshair.
Tiny bright dots wander around the crosshair to the end; one stays near the centre while others enter and leave the frame.
